explanation: She shared the 1903 physics prize with Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel, then won chemistry alone for discovering polonium and radium. She named polonium after Poland, her homeland.

claims.text: Marie Curie won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 and the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1911.
Pierre Curie won only the 1903 physics prize, Ernest Rutherford won only the 1908 chemistry prize, and Lise Meitner never won a Nobel Prize.
Marie Curie shared the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel.
Marie Curie won the 1911 Nobel Prize in Chemistry alone, for discovering polonium and radium.
Marie Curie named polonium after Poland, her homeland.
